tickets.title: Prepare side-by-side care comparison for Harold and Lena Velvetreed
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and out-of-pocket costs at multiple weekly care-hour levels for Harold and Lena Velvetreed, using Silver Marmot Insurance policy details and neurologist recommendations.
tickets.evidence: Harold asked for a side-by-side view of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels; the agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2026-01-20.

tickets.title: Build family caregiver coverage map for Velvetreed household
tickets.text: Build a family caregiver coverage map for Harold and Lena Velvetreed documenting Sofia Copperwisp's weekend availability, Martin Velvetreed's remote medication management, Harold's fatigue, and weekday evening gaps to coordinate care scheduling.
tickets.evidence: Lena’s mobility limits changed the household routine, and the family described Sofia’s weekend availability, Martin’s remote medication role, Harold’s fatigue, and gaps during weekday evenings; the agreed follow-up is to build a family caregiver coverage map by 2026-01-16.

tickets.title: Prepare Silver Marmot Insurance claim intake packet for Lena Velvetreed
tickets.text: Prepare an organized intake packet for Silver Marmot Insurance claim appointment including physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for Lena Velvetreed's long-term care claim.
tickets.evidence: Silver Marmot Insurance has a claim-intake appointment pending, and the family needs an organized packet of physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is to prepare the intake packet by 2026-01-12.

tickets.title: Resolve aide shift minimums in care cost estimates for Velvetreed household
tickets.text: Resolve inconsistent aide shift minimum assumptions in weekly care cost estimates for Harold and Lena Velvetreed, reconciling the four-hour daytime minimum from one agency quote with three-hour visits noted by Sofia Copperwisp.
tickets.evidence: One agency quote described a four-hour minimum for daytime shifts, while Sofia’s call notes showed three-hour visits, creating inconsistent assumptions in the projected weekly care cost; the agreed follow-up is to resolve the aide shift minimums in the cost estimates by 2026-01-13.

tickets.title: Correct secure upload access for Lena Velvetreed claim file
tickets.text: Correct secure upload access for Lena Velvetreed's claim file to enable a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices, currently blocked because the portal invitation opened under Harold Velvetreed's login.
tickets.evidence: Lena’s portal invitation opened under Harold’s login, preventing a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices tied to Lena’s claim file; the agreed follow-up is to correct secure upload access by 2026-01-09.

tickets.title: Address Silver Marmot Insurance policy inflation assumptions for care projections
tickets.text: Address the differing inflation rider language in Harold and Lena Velvetreed's Silver Marmot Insurance policies to ensure daily benefit maximums are shown correctly in care-cost projections, as identified in Mira Quillwhistle's review.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found that the two Silver Marmot Insurance policies use different inflation rider language, which affects how the daily benefit maximums should be shown in the care-cost projections; the agreed follow-up is to address the policy benefit inflation assumptions by 2026-01-23.
